title: Embedding preserves initial configurations
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $Q$ be a state set, let $\Sigma$ be a symbol alphabet, let $q_0\in Q$, and let $x$ be an input word over $\Sigma$. The embedding into the model with $k+1$ work tapes and state set $Q\sqcup\{0,1,2\}$ of the initial configuration on $x$ in state $q_0$ equals the initial configuration on $x$ in state given by the left inclusion of $q_0$.
replaced:
For any state $q_0$ of a machine with $k$ work tapes and any input word $x$,
the embedding into the $(k+1)$-tape oracle model of the initial configuration
in state $q_0$ on input $x$ is the initial configuration on input $x$ whose
state is the image of $q_0$ under the left inclusion into the extended state
set $Q \sqcup \{0,1,2\}$.
